svg.title: Window count dots and a resizable Dock
svg.desc: A large cartoon Dock with one dot per open window: two for Safari, one for Notes, three for Terminal and one for Music. The DogBar dog stands on the Dock and lifts its resize grip, and a dashed outline shows the bigger Dock. The icons keep a fixed size.
